name: JustLogic
description: JustLogic deductive-reasoning benchmark (Chen 2025), depths 6-7 only. 3-class TRUE/FALSE/Uncertain claim evaluation against premises. Routes through TermNorm /matches with the llm_only pipeline.

llm_only.description: Direct LLM generation on the TermNorm backend. No dataset-side max_tokens cap — provider ceiling applies. reasoning_effort=low is the conservative-floor origin; recon-measured at ~44% on the depth-6,7 stratum 2026-05-19.

reasoning.description: Work the logical chain step by step. Identify each premise; track negations, quantifiers (all/some/no) and conditionals explicitly; trace premises to the claim. Recheck each step against the stated premises before moving on.

answer.description: TRUE when the premises strictly entail the claim; FALSE when they strictly entail its negation; Uncertain ONLY when the premises genuinely do not determine the claim either way — never as a hedge against difficulty.
